meta.title: BMI Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Free BMI calculator. Enter your height and weight to get your body mass index, weight category, ideal weight, and healthy weight range. Calculated instantly in your browser, no data leaves your device.
steps_bmi-calculator_1Desc: Input your weight and height. Switch between metric (kg/cm) and imperial (lbs/ft/in) units. Your data stays private — all calculations are local.
steps_bmi-calculator_2Desc: Your BMI score and weight category (underweight, normal, overweight, or obese) display instantly. A visual scale shows where your result falls on the range.
steps_bmi-calculator_3Desc: Review the BMI category description. Note that BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnostic — consult a healthcare professional for personalized health advice.
bmi.desc: Calculate your body mass index (BMI) from height and weight, with a weight category and healthy weight range.
bmi.hint: Enter height and weight, then click Calculate
